clusters.name: Your grandfather Amos's death, 1989–1990
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother lay awake over money in March 1988 and stopped talking with your father about it by May 1988; your brother's grades fell in November 1989; your mother grew calmer once back at work by March 1990. The shifts in your mother's anxiety and the distance between your parents sit beside money trouble in the years before; your brother's functioning fell after your grandfather died.

clusters.name: Your mother Della told she had breast cancer, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Around your mother's diagnosis in February 1995, within the following year: you had migraines that kept you in bed starting March 1994, called your brother most nights from April 1994, then stopped returning his calls by June 1995 and stopped calling home by February 1996. Your symptoms rose and your moves toward and away from your brother shifted in the months around your mother's illness; every shift in these months is yours.
